pages.title: Cooperativity
pages.text: $(thing)Cooperativity$()$(br2)Haemoglobin's four sites help each other: once one holds oxygen, the rest grab it faster. Its curve is an S, not a bend (Hill).

$(thing)Insight$(): 100$(br2)$(thing)Builds on$(): Enzyme Inhibition.$(br2)$(thing)Samples$(): 2 Assayed Enzyme.$(br2)$(thing)Derivation$(): Sites that help each other bind as an S-curve with steepness n. Write the share Y of sites filled at level S, for half-filling at K.
